ig_caption:
Sun, Nov 15: 23,507 deer reported statewide (17,418 antlered, 6,089 antlerless). Season total: 126,154.

Sunday's firearm opener added 23,507 reports, more than six times the previous daily peak of 3,685 on Nov 8, yet the antlered share held at 74%, the same as Saturday. Sanilac led all counties with 761.
